No, the scan will not read that folder. As the page is currently set, `Dnn.AdminExperience/EditBar/Dnn.EditBar.UI/bin/` is left out.

It falls under the "Build output beside a project" group. That group is left out because "Leave out build output and packages" is ticked. The group lists `EditBar/Dnn.EditBar.UI/bin/` under Dnn.AdminExperience, and the folder holds 14 files. The `obj/` folder next to it is left out for the same reason. I only expanded the lists to look and didn't change any settings.

If you wanted the folder read, you would click "Keep" on that entry, or untick the checkbox. I did neither.
